# Bhavya Kamdar

> Bhavya Kamdar is a Chartered Accountant who believes every number has a story behind it. A GLS University alumnus, Bhavya wrote a first book at 16, speaks at institutions including ICAI, H. L. College of Commerce and SKIPS University, and writes Beyond Bhavya on LinkedIn (6,000+ followers). Latest book: Face Your Hope (2026). This is the official site: bhavyakamdar.com.

Key facts:
- Profession: Chartered Accountant (CA). Also an author and speaker. Alumnus of GLS University. Wrote a first book at 16.
- Latest book: Face Your Hope (Notion Press, 30 September 2026, 102 pages, ISBN 979-8-9076-3809-9). Hardcover and paperback on Amazon.in, Flipkart and Notion Press; Kindle eBook on Amazon.in (₹197.49). An audiobook is planned for early 2027.
- Central idea of Face Your Hope: to hope is to risk, and the more you act, the more places luck has to find you.
- Companion game: "The Ship Is Sinking", free to play in a browser.
- Speaking: guest sessions, panels and judging on finance, AI in finance and CA practice, public policy and careers, at ICAI Ahmedabad Branch, GLS University, H. L. College of Commerce, SKIPS University and Rising Youth Network.
- Beyond Bhavya: a series of short business and finance explainers, published on LinkedIn (6,000+ followers).
- Contact: cabhavyakamdar@gmail.com

## About
- [About Bhavya Kamdar and FAQ](https://bhavyakamdar.com/about/): Biography, quick facts and answers to common questions.
- [Home](https://bhavyakamdar.com/): Overview of the writing, speaking and thinking.

## Books
- [All books](https://bhavyakamdar.com/books/): The five books by Bhavya Kamdar.
- [Face Your Hope](https://bhavyakamdar.com/books/face-your-hope/): Auto-fiction (2026). A collection of stories from a real life, told the way memory tells them.
- [11 Weeks for Better You](https://bhavyakamdar.com/books/11-weeks-for-better-you/): Self-help (2021). One chapter a day for 11 weeks across Personal Growth, Health, Relationships, Finance, and Marketing & Selling.
- [The 31st February Story](https://bhavyakamdar.com/books/the-31st-february-story/): Sci-fi thriller (2020). A meteoroid stops Earth's rotation and two extra days appear on the calendar.
- [Open Book With Many Secrets](https://bhavyakamdar.com/books/open-book-with-many-secrets/): Mystery fantasy (2020). Anthony Oliver's life changes when he meets a girl who exists only in his dreams.
- [The Mysterious Castle](https://bhavyakamdar.com/books/the-mysterious-castle/): Adventure mystery (2017). Jack, Millie and Max search for a lost castle.

## Speaking and thinking
- [Speaking](https://bhavyakamdar.com/speaking/): Talks, panels and judging engagements, newest first.
- [Beyond Bhavya](https://bhavyakamdar.com/thinking/): Explainers on why companies win, why policies shift, and what a balance sheet doesn't say.
